notes: Client: the Android app's UploadEngine (hash on device -> session -> tus create -> resume from HEAD, PATCH sized to the observed rate for ~20 s per request between 128 KiB and the session part size, read timeout 90 s, backoff 2/5/15/30/60 s restarting whenever the server took bytes) run on the JVM by apps/android/netlab-runner; POST/GET /uploads answered by an in-process stub (netlab has no API). Stack: toxiproxy -> nginx tusd-proxy -> tusd -> MinIO (netlab overlay). Time box 240s, event scale 1.0. elapsed_s counts the transfer only; hash_s is the on-device SHA-256 before the first byte. bytes_uploaded is what the server holds (acknowledged requests and HEAD offsets, tusd keeps the bytes of a cut request); resumes counts each HEAD after a failure. Never pass: field-network-upload stage (b) is 1 GB on a real device and network (stage (a): efficiency >= 70% of Mathis, zero bytes lost on resume, netem, checksum match).
